issues.summary: The handling/error message here targets a very specific failure case; it should be made more general.
This logic is duplicated elsewhere in the code; the other places should reuse this helper.
Turn this generated content into a string template like the other one so it's easier to manage.
Platform-specific handling looks unnecessary since this only runs on Linux; add an early exit for Windows/Apple instead.
This code appears to delete the cmake file rather than override it as the earlier comment says it should.
